    assign or2 = a | b; // 1

    assign equal = not_equal;

module traffic_light (
    input clk, reset,
    output [2:0] light
);
    // Clock and reset are connected to a counter with constraints that define the lighting sequence.
    reg [2:0] state, next_state;
    
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= 3'b000;
        end else begin
            state <= next_state;
        end
    end
    
    always begin
        case (state)
            3'b000: begin
                light <= 3'b001; // Green light is on
                next_state <= 3'b001;
            end
            3'b001: begin
                light <= 3'b010; // Amber light is on
                next_state <= 3'b011;
            end
            3'b010: begin
                light <= 3'b100; // Red light is on
                next_state <= 3'b110;
            end
            3'b100: begin
                light <= 3'b101; // Amber light is on
                next_state <= 3'b111;
            end
            3'b110: begin
                light <= 3'b001; // Green light is on
                next_state <= 3'b000;
            end
            default: begin
                light <= 3'b111; // Red light is fully on, extending the red light time.
                next_state <= 3'b111;
            end
        endcase
    end
endmodule

    output [7:0] out
);
